label: input w or r during original phase (t>0)
explanation: Fires only in the original-input phase (never at t=0, essentially never at <DEL> or during copy), mainly when the input token is w or r (about 83% of activation mass; about 12% of w/r steps fire). It fires more weakly on l, x, e, k and occasionally z/n. Firing is most likely at early-to-middle positions (t=2-5) and on first occurrences of the token. Whether a given w/r fires, and how strongly, depends on the preceding context in a diffuse way: sequences that begin with j, 3, p, f or i fire more often and include the top activations, but conditioning on prefix tokens only lifts precision to about 0.4-0.5 and costs recall. So precision for w/r alone is only about 0.26.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=1: w, r; t=2: w, r, l, x; t=3: w, r, l, x) and the first original token (most: j, 3, p, f, i, 1; least: t, x, y, z); timing cues that raise it most: L=9 & t=10, t=10, L=8 & t=9.
